card.name: Mixed spots in anticoagulant and safety text
card.fires_on: Scattered words in dosing and safety text, such as the start of "donor", the middle of "anticoagulant" or "interruption", and the word "Safety" opening a sentence about safety and efficacy. No single word class stands out.

modes.label: Donor and anticoagulant words
